title: WebSocket notification push message
description: The real message shape sent over /ws by QA-DEMO-SYSTEM/backend/src/realtime/websocketServer.js#pushNotificationToUser. Deliberately narrower than the REST GET /api/notifications response shape (shared/schemas/notifications/) — the live push omits `created_at` because it is sent at creation time, before that column's DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP would be re-read; a consumer must not assume push and REST-fetch payloads are identical.
